C0149.title: MPS Reveals Typical Case in 'Account Shutdown' Operation: Insider Collusion with Account Traffickers in Telecom Fraud
C0149.summary: In February 2022, the Ministry of Public Security released typical cases from the “Duanhao” campaign against the black market for online accounts. In one Guangdong case, five insiders at a telecom operator colluded with outside actors and provided “account dealers” with 1.88 million unreleased mobile numbers and SMS gateways for malicious registration and resale of online accounts. The case involved more than 85.5 million yuan, with over 30 million yuan in illegal gains.
